overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Growth Stock ETF (TGRW) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on large cap equity. TGRW is an actively-managed, non-transparent fund that focus on companies with growth characteristics TGRW was launched on Aug 4, 2020 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
